Metadata.description: The open directory of Ireland's pharmacies, nursing homes, hospitals and health centres, from the PSI's and HIQA's registers and the HSE's open data.
Metadata.proDescription: Apercura publishes a factual page for every registered pharmacy and nursing home in Ireland, and for the HSE's hospitals and health centres. Find your facility's page and claim it for free.

SearchPage.emptyBody: Check the spelling, try a nearby town, or a broader term such as “pharmacy”.

HomePage.title: Find a pharmacy, nursing home, hospital or health centre in Ireland
HomePage.hook: Every pharmacy on the PSI's register and every nursing home on HIQA's already has a page, as do the HSE's hospitals and health centres.

free.description: Free for facilities and patients, with no subscription and no commission.

registry.heading: Built from Ireland's public registers
registry.intro: Each page starts from a public list: the Pharmaceutical Society of Ireland's register of pharmacies, HIQA's register of nursing homes, and the HSE's Health Atlas layers of hospitals and health centres. Facilities are listed, never individual clinicians. Nobody pays to be listed, and nobody is left out.

pro.heading: Do you run a pharmacy, nursing home, hospital or health centre?
pro.body: Your facility's page already exists. Claiming it is free.

HomePage.tagline: The open directory of health facilities in Ireland.

specimen.intro: This is a page as the public registers fill it, before the facility claims it: known fields are filled, the others say plainly that they are not provided.

errors.INVALID_RPPS: This key is not valid: it is the end of the address of your facility's page (a letter and digits, for example p1234), after ie:, or the whole address.

start.lead: A claim targets one facility's page, never a name.
start.contestBody: If it is your facility's (for instance you lost access to your account), you can still claim it: an administrator reviews your document and decides. Recovering an account always goes through a new verification.
start.notFound: No public page has this key yet.
start.rppsLabel: Key or address of the page
start.rppsHint: The address of your facility's page, for example apercura.org/ie/facility/example-pharmacy-p1234, or its end after ie: (ie:p1234).
start.contactLink: No document to hand? Contact us

document.summary: A document that shows you run the facility or act for it: its certificate of registration (PSI or HIQA), or a letter on its letterhead authorising you. A member of our team reviews it, usually within 48 hours.
document.lead: Send a document that shows you run the facility or act for it: its certificate of registration (PSI or HIQA), or a letter on its letterhead authorising you. It is encrypted before it is stored, and deleted 30 days after the decision.

kind.ordre_attestation: The facility's certificate of registration (PSI or HIQA)

status.contestReview: This page already had a verified owner: an administrator decides on your document.
status.reviewBody: A member of our team reviews your document and writes to you by email.
status.contestBody: An administrator will decide on your document.

Gdpr.rppsHint: The end of the address of the page (for example example-pharmacy-p1234), or the whole address.

report.doneBody: We check it. Facts from the public registers are corrected at the source, with the PSI, HIQA or the HSE, whichever publishes the list; we tell you if you left an address.

removal.doneBody: It is no longer shown, indexed or listed. We check the request and answer by email within one month at most. Once it is confirmed, the page is deleted for good and does not come back with the registers' updates.
removal.privacy: A deleted page does not come back with the next import of the public registers.
removal.claimedBody: Only its holder can remove it, from the page editor of their space: the page then disappears at once and does not come back with the registers' updates.

contact.lead: You cannot claim your facility's page with a document? Leave us your details: a member of the Apercura team gets back to you to check that you act for the facility and help you.
contact.claimFirst: With a document that shows you act for the facility, claiming is quicker:

body: We have received your claim and its documents. A member of the Apercura team reviews them and writes to you by email.
We review claims within 48 hours on working days.
We could not verify your claim. Reason given by the reviewer: {reason}
You can open a new claim from your space, with a legible document that shows you act for the facility.
The page is hidden from now on: it is no longer shown, indexed or listed.
We check the request and answer within one month at most. Once it is confirmed, the page is deleted; a deleted page does not come back with the next import of the public registers.
The page you asked us to remove has been deleted from Apercura. It will not come back with the next import of the public registers.

check.lead: Your page starts from Ireland's public registers. Check the facility's name, type and address.
check.registryNote: Something wrong? The lasting fix is made at the source, with the PSI, HIQA or the HSE, whichever publishes the list; the page follows at the next import. You can hide an address or add one in the page editor.
